summary: Headquarters lookout of the J. Clark Salyer NWR; moved in 1992 to Rugby's Prairie Village Museum, where it stands. Build year not found.

facts.status_note: Moved to Rugby in 1992; the headquarters site is listed as removed

events.note: Moved from the refuge headquarters to the Prairie Village Museum in Rugby; the register gives a cost of $12,000 after a local fundraising campaign
The Rugby structure is registered as US 1414, ND 2; the register entry is dated March 25, 2020

notes_for_editor: Build year, builder, staffing and fire history were not found in the pages read or in two searches, so the story leaves them out. The headquarters-to-Rugby link rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association pairing and the West Lookouts entry; the National Historic Lookout Register names the refuge but not the headquarters. Height is 110 ft converted to 33.5 m and applies to the structure those two sources tie to the headquarters. The 'north of Upham' detail from a search summary was not found on the FWS about-us page and is not used. The FWS Dam 326 photo is credited to the Library of Congress; its licence was not on the page read, so no photo record was made. Access to the headquarters site and the Rugby tower is unknown, so no visit facts are recorded. Duplicate risk: data/research/us-nd-salyer-nwr-hq-at-rugby.json covers the same Rugby structure and should be cross-linked or merged.
